A threat intelligence platform ingests actor profiles from Mandiant, CrowdStrike, MITRE ATT&CK, and partner ISAC feeds. The same actors appear under vendor-specific names: “Cozy Bear” (CrowdStrike), “APT29” (MITRE), “Midnight Blizzard” (Microsoft), “The Dukes” (F-Secure). Before any analyst query runs, these aliases must collapse to a single canonical node so that relationships — malware used, infrastructure operated, campaigns attributed — all attach to one place.
The alias field is the key signal here. Property-based similarity will fire strongly when any record carries the canonical name in its aliases list. Setting a moderate threshold (0.6) catches alias-based matches that name similarity alone would miss.
from semantica.deduplication import DuplicateDetector, EntityMerger

actors = [
    {"id": "ta-cs-001",  "name": "Cozy Bear",         "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29", "The Dukes"],  "country": "Russia", "source": "CrowdStrike"},
    {"id": "ta-mt-002",  "name": "APT29",              "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": [],                       "country": "Russia", "source": "MITRE"},
    {"id": "ta-ms-003",  "name": "Midnight Blizzard",  "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["NOBELIUM", "APT29"],   "country": "Russia", "source": "Microsoft"},
    {"id": "ta-fs-004",  "name": "The Dukes",          "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29", "Cozy Bear"],  "country": "Russia", "source": "F-Secure"},
    {"id": "ta-mt-005",  "name": "APT28",              "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["Fancy Bear"],           "country": "Russia", "source": "MITRE"},
]

detector = DuplicateDetector(similarity_threshold=0.6, confidence_threshold=0.5)
groups = detector.detect_duplicate_groups(actors)

merger = EntityMerger(preserve_provenance=True)
for group in groups:
    if len(group.entities) < 2:
        continue
    ops = merger.merge_duplicates(group.entities, strategy="keep_most_complete")
    for op in ops:
        feeds = [e["source"] for e in op.source_entities]
        print(f"Canonical: {op.merged_entity['name']!r}  (merged from: {feeds})")
        # Canonical: 'APT29'  (merged from: ['CrowdStrike', 'MITRE', 'Microsoft', 'F-Secure'])
        # All four actor nodes collapse to one — every relationship they held now
        # attaches to the canonical APT29 node.

​
Choosing the right threshold
The similarity threshold controls sensitivity. Start at 0.7 and examine false positives before adjusting:
0.95 and above — near-exact string matches only. Use for codes and IDs (LEI, CAS, CVE-ID) where name format is consistent across feeds.
0.80–0.95 — catches typographic variants: “Apple Inc.” vs “Apple, Inc.”, “BlackRock” vs “BlackRock Inc.”
0.65–0.80 — catches abbreviations and short forms. Necessary for organization names that appear in both long and short forms across feeds.
0.50–0.65 — semantic similarity territory. Requires property or embedding signals to compensate for weak name similarity. Use this range for alias-based matching where names may be completely different strings referring to the same entity.
​
Choosing a merge strategy
STRATEGY	USE WHEN
keep_most_complete	You don’t have a designated authoritative source; maximize information density. Default choice.
keep_first	Your first source is a golden-record system (MDM, LEI registry) whose data should never be overwritten.
keep_highest_confidence	Your entities carry explicit confidence scores and you trust them as a quality signal.
merge_all	You want a superset of all properties; acceptable when you’ll run conflict resolution afterwards to reconcile disagreements.

Use merge_entity_group() when you already know which entities are duplicates and just need to merge a pre-determined group
Don’t mix functional wrappers with class APIs in the same workflow—choose one approach and stick with it
The deduplication module detects duplicate entities across multi-source knowledge graphs using six complementary similarity algorithms — exact match, Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, cosine, property comparison, and vector embedding — then merges them into a single canonical entity while preserving full provenance. Use it to collapse alias clusters (e.g. “APT29”, “Cozy Bear”, “Midnight Blizzard”) before running graph analytics or conflict resolution.
Run deduplication after ingestion and before conflict resolution. Deduplication collapses duplicate nodes into one canonical entity. Conflict resolution then reconciles disagreeing property values on that canonical entity. The pipeline order matters: deduplicate first, then resolve conflicts, then validate with SHACL.
​
Finding your duplicates: the first scan
Start with detect_duplicates() for straightforward duplicate detection on smaller datasets. Point it at your entities and let the pairwise algorithm compare every pair using multiple similarity signals.
Scaling consideration: For datasets of a few thousand nodes, this runs in seconds. The O(n²) pairwise comparison cost only becomes problematic above ten thousand entities—for larger sets, see the clustering section below.
from semantica.deduplication import detect_duplicates

# Threat actors ingested from four different CTI feeds — same actors, different names
threat_actors = [
    {"id": "ta-nvd-001",  "name": "APT29",            "type": "ThreatActor",
     "country": "Russia",  "source": "MISP"},
    {"id": "ta-of-002",   "name": "APT-29",            "type": "ThreatActor",
     "country": "Russia",  "source": "OpenCTI"},
    {"id": "ta-rf-003",   "name": "Cozy Bear",         "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29"], "country": "Russia", "source": "RecordedFuture"},
    {"id": "ta-sx-004",   "name": "The Dukes",         "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29", "Cozy Bear"], "country": "Russia", "source": "STIX-partner"},
    {"id": "ta-ms-005",   "name": "Midnight Blizzard", "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["NOBELIUM", "APT29"], "country": "Russia", "source": "Microsoft"},
    {"id": "ta-ap-006",   "name": "APT28",             "type": "ThreatActor",
     "country": "Russia",  "source": "MISP"},  # different actor — should NOT match
]

candidates = detect_duplicates(
    threat_actors,
    method="pairwise",          # compare every pair
    similarity_threshold=0.6,   # minimum score to flag as a candidate
    confidence_threshold=0.5,   # minimum confidence in the match
)

for c in candidates:
    print(f"{c.entity1['name']!r}  ~  {c.entity2['name']!r}")
    print(f"  similarity={c.similarity_score:.2f}  confidence={c.confidence:.2f}")
    print(f"  signals: {c.reasons}")
    print()

'APT29'  ~  'APT-29'
  similarity=0.89  confidence=0.81
  signals: ['levenshtein', 'jaro_winkler']

'APT29'  ~  'Cozy Bear'
  similarity=0.63  confidence=0.71
  signals: ['property', 'relationship']   # alias field matched

'Cozy Bear'  ~  'The Dukes'
  similarity=0.61  confidence=0.68
  signals: ['property']                   # shared alias "APT29"

'APT29'  ~  'Midnight Blizzard'
  similarity=0.65  confidence=0.73
  signals: ['property']                   # alias "APT29" in Midnight Blizzard record

The scores tell a clear story. “APT29” and “APT-29” score 0.89 — the hyphen is the only difference, producing strong string similarity signals. “Cozy Bear” and “The Dukes” score lower (0.61) because the names are completely dissimilar, but the property signal fires because both records carry "APT29" in their aliases list. “APT28” never appears in the results because it shares only the country field — not enough to cross the 0.6 threshold.
​
Understanding the candidate object
Each DuplicateCandidate carries the two entities, their similarity scores, and a detailed breakdown of which similarity algorithms contributed to the match. This provides full transparency for audit and threshold tuning:
from semantica.deduplication import calculate_similarity

# Inspect a single pair in detail before committing to a merge
e1 = threat_actors[0]   # APT29
e2 = threat_actors[2]   # Cozy Bear

result = calculate_similarity(e1, e2, method="multi_factor")

print(f"Overall score : {result.score:.2f}")
print(f"Method        : {result.method}")
print(f"Components    :")
for algo, score in result.components.items():
    print(f"  {algo:<20} {score:.2f}")

Overall score : 0.63
Method        : multi_factor
Components    :
  exact                0.00   # names are completely different strings
  levenshtein          0.12   # high edit distance between "APT29" and "Cozy Bear"
  jaro_winkler         0.21   # no shared prefix
  property             0.94   # alias match is nearly definitive
  relationship         0.71   # share relationships to overlapping malware families
  embedding            0.78   # semantic vectors land in the same cluster

The property component (0.94) is doing most of the work here. “Cozy Bear“‘s record carries aliases: ["APT29"], which creates an almost-definitive signal that these entities refer to the same threat actor. When you see a pattern like this — weak name similarity but strong property matching — you’re typically looking at a genuine alias relationship rather than a false positive.
​
Grouping duplicates before merging
For small datasets, you can merge candidate pairs directly. For larger graphs where the same entity might appear under six different names across twelve feeds, use duplicate grouping with Union-Find clustering. This ensures that if A matches B and B matches C, all three entities are grouped together even if A and C don’t directly meet the similarity threshold:
from semantica.deduplication import DuplicateDetector, EntityMerger

detector = DuplicateDetector(
    similarity_threshold=0.6,
    confidence_threshold=0.5,
    use_clustering=True,      # enable Union-Find grouping
)

groups = detector.detect_duplicate_groups(threat_actors)

print(f"Found {len(groups)} duplicate groups:")
for group in groups:
    names = [e["name"] for e in group.entities]
    print(f"  Group (confidence={group.confidence:.2f}): {names}")
    if group.representative:
        print(f"  Representative: {group.representative['name']!r}")

Found 2 duplicate groups:
  Group (confidence=0.74): ['APT29', 'APT-29', 'Cozy Bear', 'The Dukes', 'Midnight Blizzard']
  Representative: 'APT29'   # highest completeness score in the group

  Group (confidence=0.81): ['APT28', 'Fancy Bear']
  Representative: 'APT28'

The group result shows the consolidation clearly: five separate nodes that should be one canonical entity. The representative field identifies the entity the merger will use as the base — typically the one with the most complete attribute set, in this case “APT29” from the MISP feed.
​
Merging: collapsing the group without losing data
Once you have identified duplicate groups, the merging process consolidates them into canonical entities. The keep_most_complete strategy selects the entity with the highest property count as the canonical node and enriches it with any missing fields from the other sources:
merger = EntityMerger(preserve_provenance=True)

for group in groups:
    if len(group.entities) < 2:
        continue

    # merge_entity_group() skips duplicate detection since `group.entities`
    # is already a confirmed group from detect_duplicate_groups()
    op = merger.merge_entity_group(group.entities, strategy="keep_most_complete")

    canonical = op.merged_entity
    source_ids = [e["id"] for e in op.source_entities]
    print(f"Merged {len(op.source_entities)} entities → canonical: {canonical['name']!r}")
    print(f"  Source IDs retired : {source_ids}")
    print(f"  Merge strategy     : {op.merge_result.metadata.get('strategy')}")

Merged 5 entities → canonical: 'APT29'
  Source IDs retired : ['ta-nvd-001', 'ta-of-002', 'ta-rf-003', 'ta-sx-004', 'ta-ms-005']
  Merge strategy     : keep_most_complete

The five source entities are replaced by one canonical representation. Every relationship those five nodes carried — to campaigns, malware families, TTPs, infrastructure — now attaches to the canonical “APT29” node. The merge operation preserves all information while eliminating redundancy, and the provenance records show exactly which feed contributed each attribute.
​
Reviewing merge history for audit
After batch merging operations, you can retrieve the complete history to review every decision made. This audit trail is essential for understanding merge decisions and explaining them to stakeholders:
history = merger.get_merge_history()

print(f"Total merge operations: {len(history)}")
for op in history:
    print(f"  {op.merged_entity['name']!r} ← {len(op.source_entities)} sources")
    print(f"    strategy: {op.merge_result.metadata.get('strategy')}")

This history provides complete transparency about merge decisions. When a feed owner asks why their entity was merged into another one, you have the documented evidence and reasoning for the decision.
​
Streaming ingestion: incremental deduplication
When your pipeline processes continuous data streams — new threat intelligence arriving hourly — you don’t want to re-run pairwise comparison over the entire graph on every batch. Use incremental detection to compare only new entities against the existing canonical set:
# Existing graph entities (already deduplicated)
existing_actors = [
    {"id": "ta-nvd-001", "name": "APT29", "type": "ThreatActor", "country": "Russia"},
]

# New batch arriving from a fresh feed
new_batch = [
    {"id": "ta-new-007", "name": "NOBELIUM",      "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29"], "country": "Russia", "source": "MSTIC-2026-06"},
    {"id": "ta-new-008", "name": "Scattered Spider", "type": "ThreatActor",
     "country": "Unknown",  "source": "CrowdStrike"},
]

incremental = detector.incremental_detect(new_batch, existing_actors)

print(f"New duplicates found in this batch: {len(incremental)}")
for c in incremental:
    print(f"  {c.entity1['name']!r} matches existing {c.entity2['name']!r}")
    print(f"  score={c.similarity_score:.2f}")

New duplicates found in this batch: 1
  'NOBELIUM' matches existing 'APT29'
  score=0.67        # alias field carries "APT29" — property signal fires

NOBELIUM gets queued for merging with the existing APT29 canonical entity. Scattered Spider scores below threshold against every existing actor and gets added to the graph as a new, unique node.
​
Scaling to large entity sets
For graphs above ten thousand nodes, pairwise comparison becomes computationally expensive due to its O(n²) complexity. Use build_clusters() to run more efficient vectorized batch comparison, then merge each resulting cluster:
Performance warning: Always profile your similarity operations on representative data sizes. What works for 1,000 entities may become unacceptably slow at 10,000+ entities without appropriate scaling strategies.
from semantica.deduplication import build_clusters

# Ten thousand CVE entities from NVD, Vulhub, and vendor feeds
# (not shown — assume `all_vulns` is a list of 10k+ dicts)

cluster_result = build_clusters(
    all_vulns,
    method="graph_based",        # Union-Find over similarity graph
    similarity_threshold=0.75,
)

print(f"Clusters found   : {len(cluster_result.clusters)}")
print(f"Unclustered      : {len(cluster_result.unclustered)}")
print(f"Quality metrics  : {cluster_result.quality_metrics}")

# Merge each cluster
merger = EntityMerger(preserve_provenance=True)
for cluster in cluster_result.clusters:
    if len(cluster.entities) > 1:
        # Use merge_entity_group() since clustering already determined these are duplicates
        merger.merge_entity_group(cluster.entities, strategy="keep_most_complete")

For even larger sets, switch to method="hierarchical" which uses agglomerative bottom-up clustering and scales to hundreds of thousands of entities at the cost of some precision.
​
A Simple Example: Customer Deduplication
Before exploring domain-specific cases, let’s walk through a straightforward customer deduplication scenario. A company’s CRM system has accumulated duplicate customer records from web signups, sales team entries, and support tickets:
from semantica.deduplication import detect_duplicates, merge_entities

customers = [
    {"id": "cust-001", "name": "John Smith", "email": "john.smith@email.com", 
     "company": "Acme Corp", "source": "web_signup"},
    {"id": "cust-002", "name": "J. Smith", "email": "john.smith@email.com",
     "company": "Acme Corporation", "source": "sales_team"},
    {"id": "cust-003", "name": "John Smith", "phone": "+1-555-0123",
     "company": "Acme Corp", "source": "support_ticket"},
    {"id": "cust-004", "name": "Jane Doe", "email": "jane.doe@email.com",
     "company": "Beta Inc", "source": "web_signup"},
]

# Step 1: Find potential duplicates
candidates = detect_duplicates(
    customers,
    method="pairwise",
    similarity_threshold=0.6,  # 60% similarity required
    confidence_threshold=0.5,
)

print("Potential duplicates found:")
for c in candidates:
    print(f"  {c.entity1['name']} ~ {c.entity2['name']} (score: {c.similarity_score:.2f})")
    print(f"    Matching signals: {c.reasons}")

# Expected output:
# John Smith ~ J. Smith (score: 0.82)
#   Matching signals: ['exact', 'property']  # same email
# John Smith ~ John Smith (score: 0.78)  
#   Matching signals: ['exact', 'property']  # same name and company

# Step 2: Merge the duplicates
john_smith_records = [customers[0], customers[1], customers[2]]  # All John Smith variants
merged_ops = merge_entities(john_smith_records, method="keep_most_complete")

for op in merged_ops:
    canonical = op.merged_entity
    print(f"\nCanonical customer: {canonical['name']}")
    print(f"  Email: {canonical.get('email', 'N/A')}")
    print(f"  Phone: {canonical.get('phone', 'N/A')}")
    print(f"  Company: {canonical['company']}")
    print(f"  Merged from {len(op.source_entities)} records")
    
# Result: One John Smith record with email, phone, and company information
# from all three original records, with full provenance tracking

This example demonstrates the core concepts: similarity detection finds related records, and merging consolidates them into canonical entities that preserve all available information.
​
Common Pitfalls
Threshold tuning without validation. Setting thresholds too low creates false positive merges between genuinely different entities. Always manually review a sample of detected duplicates before running large-scale merging operations.
Pairwise scaling problems. The O(n²) cost of comparing every entity pair becomes prohibitive above 10,000 entities. Use clustering methods (build_clusters) or switch to vectorized similarity for large datasets.
Using fuzzy matching when primary keys exist. If your entities have reliable unique identifiers (LEI codes, CVE IDs, ISBN numbers), use exact matching on those fields instead of computationally expensive similarity algorithms.
Mixing wrapper and class APIs inconsistently. Don’t call detect_duplicates() then manually instantiate EntityMerger—choose either the functional approach or class-based approach and use it consistently throughout your workflow.
Ignoring merge strategy implications. keep_first overwrites later records completely, merge_all can introduce conflicting values, and keep_most_complete may not respect source authority. Choose the strategy that matches your data quality requirements.
Skipping provenance tracking. Without preserve_provenance=True, you lose visibility into which source contributed each field in the canonical entity, making audit trails impossible.
Inadequate similarity algorithm selection. Pure string similarity fails for alias relationships (“APT29” vs “Cozy Bear”), while property matching may be too aggressive for entities with shared attributes but different identities.
​
Domain examples
Defense — CTI/Threat
Security — SOC/Incident
Life Science — Clinical/Pharma
Banking — Risk/Compliance
A threat intelligence platform ingests actor profiles from Mandiant, CrowdStrike, MITRE ATT&CK, and partner ISAC feeds. The same actors appear under vendor-specific names: “Cozy Bear” (CrowdStrike), “APT29” (MITRE), “Midnight Blizzard” (Microsoft), “The Dukes” (F-Secure). Before any analyst query runs, these aliases must collapse to a single canonical node so that relationships — malware used, infrastructure operated, campaigns attributed — all attach to one place.
The alias field is the key signal here. Property-based similarity will fire strongly when any record carries the canonical name in its aliases list. Setting a moderate threshold (0.6) catches alias-based matches that name similarity alone would miss.
from semantica.deduplication import DuplicateDetector, EntityMerger

actors = [
    {"id": "ta-cs-001",  "name": "Cozy Bear",         "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29", "The Dukes"],  "country": "Russia", "source": "CrowdStrike"},
    {"id": "ta-mt-002",  "name": "APT29",              "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": [],                       "country": "Russia", "source": "MITRE"},
    {"id": "ta-ms-003",  "name": "Midnight Blizzard",  "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["NOBELIUM", "APT29"],   "country": "Russia", "source": "Microsoft"},
    {"id": "ta-fs-004",  "name": "The Dukes",          "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["APT29", "Cozy Bear"],  "country": "Russia", "source": "F-Secure"},
    {"id": "ta-mt-005",  "name": "APT28",              "type": "ThreatActor",
     "aliases": ["Fancy Bear"],           "country": "Russia", "source": "MITRE"},
]

detector = DuplicateDetector(similarity_threshold=0.6, confidence_threshold=0.5)
groups = detector.detect_duplicate_groups(actors)

merger = EntityMerger(preserve_provenance=True)
for group in groups:
    if len(group.entities) < 2:
        continue
    ops = merger.merge_duplicates(group.entities, strategy="keep_most_complete")
    for op in ops:
        feeds = [e["source"] for e in op.source_entities]
        print(f"Canonical: {op.merged_entity['name']!r}  (merged from: {feeds})")
        # Canonical: 'APT29'  (merged from: ['CrowdStrike', 'MITRE', 'Microsoft', 'F-Secure'])
        # All four actor nodes collapse to one — every relationship they held now
        # attaches to the canonical APT29 node.

​
Choosing the right threshold
The similarity threshold controls sensitivity. Start at 0.7 and examine false positives before adjusting:
0.95 and above — near-exact string matches only. Use for codes and IDs (LEI, CAS, CVE-ID) where name format is consistent across feeds.
0.80–0.95 — catches typographic variants: “Apple Inc.” vs “Apple, Inc.”, “BlackRock” vs “BlackRock Inc.”
0.65–0.80 — catches abbreviations and short forms. Necessary for organization names that appear in both long and short forms across feeds.
0.50–0.65 — semantic similarity territory. Requires property or embedding signals to compensate for weak name similarity. Use this range for alias-based matching where names may be completely different strings referring to the same entity.
​
Choosing a merge strategy
STRATEGY	USE WHEN
keep_most_complete	You don’t have a designated authoritative source; maximize information density. Default choice.
keep_first	Your first source is a golden-record system (MDM, LEI registry) whose data should never be overwritten.
keep_highest_confidence	Your entities carry explicit confidence scores and you trust them as a quality signal.
merge_all	You want a superset of all properties; acceptable when you’ll run conflict resolution afterwards to reconcile disagreements.
​

Now let me compose the analysis the user asked for:

1. **Semantica 的架构**：27 模块 / 6 层，每个模块可独立 import。
2. **模块清单与作用**（表格，按 6 层）
3. **映射到本项目的七道工序**：哪一步 Semantica 独立可用、哪一步 Semantica+LLM 组合、哪一步不建议用
4. **关键约束/顺序**（文档明确写了：conflicts 必须在 deduplication 之后、SHACL 之前；ontology 从图生成等）

Let me be precise and cite the docs.

Key extracted facts:
- 27 modules, 6 layers:
  1. Input Layer: ingest, parse, split, normalize
  2. Core Processing: semantic_extract, kg, ontology, reasoning
  3. Storage: embeddings, vector_store, graph_store, triplet_store
  4. Quality Assurance: deduplication, conflicts
  5. Context & Memory: context, provenance, change_management
  6. Output & Orchestration: export, visualization, pipeline, explorer
  + Utilities: llms, mcp_server, seed, evals, core, utils

- Key classes per module (from Module Index)
- Common chains: Document→KG = Ingest→Parse→Normalize→Semantic Extract→GraphBuilder→KG
- conflicts: "Run conflict detection after deduplication and before SHACL validation."
- semantic_extract methods: "pattern" (no API key), "ml" (spaCy), "llm" (9 providers)
- ontology: OntologyGenerator derives OWL from existing graph; SHACLGenerator; OntologyValidator
- reasoning: 8 modes incl. LLM-based graph reasoning
- provenance: W3C PROV-O, SHA-256 checksums, SQLite
- context: AgentContext, record_decision, find_precedents, get_causal_chain, query_with_reasoning (GraphRAG)
- pipeline: PipelineBuilder for reproducible multi-step pipelines

Now the mapping to my 7 stages + where LLM is needed:

| 工序 | Semantica 模块 | 独立可用？ | +LLM 组合？ |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 归一化 | `ingest` + `parse` + `normalize` | ✅ 纯确定性（FileIngestor 支持 docx/pdf/pptx/csv/…；DocumentParser/DoclingParser 出 full_text+tables+pages） | 可选：DoclingParser OCR/版面；semantic_transformer 分块需模型 |
| 2 骨架抽取 | 无直接对应（Semantica 无"章节骨架"概念）→ 可用 `normalize` + 自研 | ⚠️ 需自实现 | — |
| 3 切块 | `split` (TextSplitter) 12 种方法 | ✅ sentence/paragraph/recursive 确定性 | ✅ `semantic_transformer`/`llm`/`ontology_aware`/`graph_based` 需模型或 LLM |
| 4 本体抽取（事实/规则/论断/证据） | `semantic_extract`（NER/Relation/Triplet/Event/Coreference/SemanticAnalyzer）+ `kg.GraphBuilder` | ✅ `pattern` 方法无需 API key；TripletExtractor(pattern) 出 SPO | ✅ `method="llm"` 走 9 家 provider —— 这正是"Semantica+LLM 组合" |
| 4' 实体消歧 | `deduplication`（DuplicateDetector/EntityMerger） | ✅ 相似度匹配 | 可选 |
| 5 推演回放 | `reasoning`（forward/backward/Datalog/SPARQL/RETE/temporal/LLM） | ✅ 前 7 种确定性 | ✅ 第 8 种 LLM-based graph reasoning |
| 6 质量登记（冲突/缺口/闸门） | `conflicts`（ConflictDetector/ConflictResolver，7 策略）+ `ontology.SHACLGenerator`+`OntologyValidator` | ✅ 检测确定；**解决策略**里 credibility-weighted voting / most-recent 会"落裁定" ⚠️ | ✅ `expert review` 策略 = 交人/LLM 复核 |
| 6' 版本与变更 | `change_management`（checksums/rollback） | ✅ | — |
| 7 脱敏索引 | `export`（RDF/Parquet/Cypher/Arango）+ `embeddings`+`vector_store` | ✅ | — |
| 溯源（全程） | `provenance`（W3C PROV-O, SHA-256, SQLite） | ✅ | — |

# 一、Semantica 的架构

官方原话：**「Every Semantica module works independently: use only what you need.」** —— 27 个模块分 6 层，每个模块可单独 import，不用不付费。

```
Input Layer          ingest · parse · split · normalize
Core Processing      semantic_extract · kg · ontology · reasoning
Storage              embeddings · vector_store · graph_store · triplet_store
Quality Assurance    deduplication · conflicts
Context & Memory     context · provenance · change_management
Output & Orchestration  export · visualization · pipeline · explorer
Utilities            llms · mcp_server · seed · evals · core · utils
```

# 二、模块作用（含关键类）

| 层 | 模块 | 作用 | 关键类 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Input | `ingest` | 从文件/网页/数据库/流加载（PDF/DOCX/CSV/XLSX/PPTX/JSON/HTML/压缩包…21 种 ingestor） | FileIngestor, WebIngestor, DBIngestor |
| | `parse` | 抽正文与版面元数据（表格、OCR、多栏） | DocumentParser, DoclingParser |
| | `split` | 12 种切块法：recursive / token / sentence / paragraph / **semantic_transformer** / entity_aware / relation_aware / graph_based / ontology_aware / hierarchical / community_detection / centrality_based / llm | TextSplitter |
| | `normalize` | 文本清洗、实体归一、日期/数字/编码归一、语言识别 | TextNormalizer, EntityNormalizer, LanguageDetector |
| Core | `semantic_extract` | NER / 关系 / **三元组** / 事件 / 共指消解 / 抽取校验；三种方法 `pattern`（无 key）/ `ml`（spaCy）/ `llm`（9 家 provider） | NERExtractor, RelationExtractor, TripletExtractor, ExtractionValidator |
| | `kg` | 建图、图算法、**时间有效性**（valid_from/valid_until）、相似度 | GraphBuilder, TemporalGraphQuery, GraphAnalyzer |
| | `ontology` | 从**已有图**自动生成 OWL；生成 SHACL 形状；校验 | OntologyGenerator, SHACLGenerator, OntologyValidator |
| | `reasoning` | **8 种推理**：前向链 / 后向链 / Datalog / SPARQL / RETE / 时间区间 / **LLM 图推理** / 自然语言解释 | Reasoner, DatalogReasoner |
| Storage | `embeddings` `vector_store` `graph_store` `triplet_store` | 向量生成与检索、图库（Neo4j/FalkorDB）、RDF 三元组库 | EmbeddingGenerator, VectorStore, TripletStore |
| Quality | `deduplication` | 多因子相似度找重复实体 → 合并为 canonical | DuplicateDetector, EntityMerger, ClusterBuilder |
| | `conflicts` | 检测多源对**同一实体属性**的分歧；**7 种解决策略**（可信度加权投票 / 最近优先 / 专家复核…） | ConflictDetector, ConflictResolver, SourceTracker |
| Context | `context` | Agent 记忆、`record_decision` / `find_precedents` / `get_causal_chain` / GraphRAG 查询 | AgentContext, ContextGraph |
| | `provenance` | W3C PROV-O 血缘、SHA-256 完整性校验、SQLite 持久化 | ProvenanceManager |
| | `change_management` | 图版本控制、校验和、回滚 | TemporalVersionManager |
| Output | `export` | RDF Turtle / JSON-LD / N-Triples / Parquet / Cypher / Arango AQL | RDFExporter, ParquetExporter |
| | `visualization` `pipeline` `explorer` | 可视化、可复现多步流水线、知识浏览器 | KGVisualizer, PipelineBuilder |

# 三、映射到我们的七道工序（核心）

| 工序 | 可用模块 | **独立工作** | **Semantica + LLM 组合** | 我们现状 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 归一化 | `ingest`+`parse`+`normalize` | ✅ 纯确定性（docx/pdf/pptx 直读） | DoclingParser 的 OCR/版面 | 自研 stage_1 |
| 2 骨架抽取 | 无对应模块 | — | — | 自研（Semantica 无"章节骨架"概念） |
| 3 切块 | `split` | ✅ sentence/paragraph/recursive | `semantic_transformer`/`llm`/`entity_aware`/`ontology_aware` | 自研 1208 chunk（按空行+标题） |
| 4 本体抽取 | `semantic_extract`+`kg.GraphBuilder` | ✅ `pattern` 免 key 出 SPO | ✅ `method="llm"` 走 9 家 provider | **我 LLM 手抽 442 事实** |
| 4′ 消歧 | `deduplication` | ✅ 相似度匹配 | 阈值可调 | 未做（我用 subject 唯一性硬约束） |
| 5 推演回放 | `reasoning` | ✅ 前 7 种（Datalog/RETE/时间区间…） | ✅ 第 8 种 LLM 图推理 | 自研 replay + 31 条规则 |
| 6 质量登记 | `conflicts` + `ontology.SHACL` | ✅ 检测确定 | `expert review` 策略 | 自研 13 冲突 + kp_toolkit 校验 |
| 6′ 版本 | `change_management` | ✅ checksum/rollback | — | 未做 |
| 7 脱敏索引 | `export`+`embeddings`+`vector_store` | ✅ | — | 自研 skeletons + parquet |
| 全程溯源 | `provenance` | ✅ PROV-O + SHA-256 | — | 自研 provenance.yaml |
| 决策台账 | `context` | ✅ record_decision | ✅ query_with_reasoning（GraphRAG） | 未做 |

**结论：27 个模块里，至少 8 个能直接替我们某道工序的一部分，5 道工序可独立工作。**

# 四、官方三条硬约束（顺序不能乱）

1. **`conflicts` 必须跑在 `deduplication` 之后、SHACL 之前** —— 官方原话：「Running them out of order — detecting conflicts before deduplication — will produce spurious conflicts」。这正好对上我们工序 6 的内部顺序。
2. **`ontology` 从已有图反推**（OntologyGenerator 吃 entities/relationships）→ 必须建图之后才能生成 OWL/SHACL。
3. **官方 Document→KG 链路**：`Ingest → Parse → Normalize → Semantic Extract → GraphBuilder → KG` —— 与我们的 1→3→4→建图 基本同构。

# 五、修正我上一轮的结论

我上一轮说「Semantica 不适用」—— **那句话只在 corpus_pipeline 那个桥接函数（`bootstrap_claim_ontology`）范围内成立**，因为那条桥只做 Schema 演进。但从**模块级**看，Semantica 能在 5 道工序独立工作，我当时的判断面太窄了，这是我的疏漏。

===== conflicts: 完整示例（67-110 行） =====
from semantica.conflicts import ConflictDetector, ConflictResolver, ResolutionStrategy

# Same customer, three sources — only email disagrees
customer_records = [
    {"id": "cust-001", "source": "crm",  "email": "alice@example.com",       "phone": "+1-555-0100"},
    {"id": "cust-001", "source": "erp",  "email": "alice.smith@example.com", "phone": "+1-555-0100"},
    {"id": "cust-001", "source": "ldap", "email": "alice.smith@example.com", "phone": "+1-555-0100"},
]

# Step 1: Detect all property conflicts at once — no need to name each property
detector = ConflictDetector()
conflicts = detector.detect_entity_conflicts(customer_records)

print(f"Conflicts found: {len(conflicts)}")
for c in conflicts:
    print(f"  Property : {c.property_name}")
    print(f"  Values   : {c.conflicting_values}")
    print(f"  Severity : {c.severity}")

# Step 2: Resolve — two out of three sources agree, so majority vote wins
resolver = ConflictResolver()
results = resolver.resolve_conflicts(conflicts, strategy=ResolutionStrategy.VOTING)

for r in results:
    print(f"\n[{'RESOLVED' if r.resolved else 'REVIEW'}] {r.conflict_id}")
    print(f"  Resolved value : {r.resolved_value}")
    print(f"  Strategy       : {r.resolution_strategy}")
    print(f"  Confidence     : {r.confidence:.0%}")
    print(f"  Sources used   : {r.sources_used}")

Conflicts found: 1
  Property : email
  Values   : ['alice@example.com', 'alice.smith@example.com', 'alice.smith@example.com']
  Severity : medium

[RESOLVED] cust-001_email_conflict
  Resolved value : alice.smith@example.com
  Strategy       : voting
  Confidence     : 67%
  Sources used   : ['crm', 'erp', 'ldap']

detect_entity_conflicts() scanned both email and phone automatically — you did not name them. Because phone is identical across all three records, no conflict was detected for it. The email disagreement resolves to alice.smith@example.com because two of three sources agree on that value.
When every conflict in a batch should use the same strategy, pass strategy= directly to resolve_conflicts(). Use set_resolution_rule() when different entity-property pairs need different strategies — explained in Setting per-property resolution rules.
​

const py = String.raw`# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Semantica 接入：P0 冲突第二双眼睛 + 抽取交叉校验；P1 实体消歧 + PROV-O 溯源；P2 切块对照。

"""
import json, sys, time, statistics
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict, Counter

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PKG = WS / "知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研"
OUT = PKG / "外部核验"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(OUT / "provenance").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def jload(p, default=None):
    p = Path(p)
    if not p.exists(): return default
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

nodes = jload(PKG / "graph/nodes.yaml", [])
rels = jload(PKG / "graph/relations.yaml", [])
chunks = [json.loads(l) for l in (PKG / "chunks/chunks.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l]
conf_curated = jload(PKG / "quality/conflicts.yaml", [])
print(f"载入：事实 {len(nodes)} 条 | 关系 {len(rels)} 条 | chunk {len(chunks)} 条 | 现有冲突 {len(conf_curated)} 项")

report = {"semantica_version": None, "runs": {}}
import semantica
report["semantica_version"] = getattr(semantica, "__version__", "?")

# ============================ P0-a 冲突检测 ============================ #
from semantica.conflicts import ConflictDetector
t0 = time.time()
records = [{"id": n["subject"], "source": n["source"], "value": str(n["value"]),
            "unit": n.get("unit", "") or "—", "node": n["id"]} for n in nodes]
det = ConflictDetector()
c_val = det.detect_entity_conflicts(records)          # 全属性扫描
c_unit = det.detect_value_conflicts(records, "unit")  # 口径（单位）分歧
elapsed_a = time.time() - t0

def c2d(c):
    d = {}
    for k in ("conflict_id", "property_name", "conflicting_values", "severity", "entity_id",
              "conflict_type", "sources", "source_count", "detected_at", "metadata", "description"):
        if hasattr(c, k):
            v = getattr(c, k)
            d[k] = v if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool, type(None))) else str(v)
    return d

sa = [c2d(c) for c in c_val]
sa_unit = [c2d(c) for c in c_unit]
# 只保留 value 属性的分歧（entity_id 即 subject）
val_conf = [c for c in sa if str(c.get("property_name")) == "value"]
print(f"[P0-a] ConflictDetector: 全属性 {len(sa)} 项 / value 属性 {len(val_conf)} 项 / unit 属性 {len(sa_unit)} 项  ({elapsed_a:.1f}s)")
report["runs"]["P0a_conflicts"] = {"module": "semantica.conflicts.ConflictDetector",
    "methods": ["detect_entity_conflicts", "detect_value_conflicts"],
    "total_all_props": len(sa), "value_conflicts": val_conf, "unit_conflicts": sa_unit,
    "elapsed_s": round(elapsed_a, 2),
    "rule": "只检测，不调用 ConflictResolver（项目铁律：冲突一律待审，不裁决）"}

# ============================ P0-b 抽取交叉校验 ============================ #
cross = {"module": "semantica.semantic_extract", "methods_tried": [], "probe": [], "summary": {}}
try:
    from semantica.semantic_extract import NERExtractor, RelationExtractor  # type: ignore
except Exception:
    from semantica.semantic_extract.ner_extractor import NERExtractor
    from semantica.semantic_extract.relation_extractor import RelationExtractor
sample = [chunks[i] for i in (108, 336, 1126) if i < len(chunks)]
for meth in ("pattern", "ml"):
    try:
        t1 = time.time()
        ner = NERExtractor(method=meth)
        ents = ner.extract(sample[0]["text"])
        cross["methods_tried"].append({"method": meth, "ok": True, "sample_entities": len(ents)})
        cross["probe"].append({"method": meth, "chunk": sample[0]["id"],
                               "entities": [str(getattr(e, "text", e))[:40] for e in ents[:10]]})
        print(f"[P0-b] NERExtractor(method={meth}) 可用，样例抽到 {len(ents)} 个实体 ({time.time()-t1:.1f}s)")
    except Exception as e:
        cross["methods_tried"].append({"method": meth, "ok": False, "error": str(e)[:160]})
        print(f"[P0-b] NERExtractor(method={meth}) 不可用：{str(e)[:120]}")
(OUT / "extraction-crosscheck.yaml").write_text(json.dumps(cross, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
(OUT / "conflicts-semantica.yaml").write_text(json.dumps(report["runs"]["P0a_conflicts"], ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("P0 落盘完成")

arguments.content:
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""P0-b 探测 + P1 实体消歧与 PROV-O 溯源 + P2 切块对照。"""
import json, os, time, statistics
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PKG = WS / "知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研"
OUT = PKG / "外部核验"; OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(OUT / "provenance").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

nodes = json.loads((PKG / "graph/nodes.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
rels = json.loads((PKG / "graph/relations.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
chunks = [json.loads(l) for l in (PKG / "chunks/chunks.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if l]
conf_curated = json.loads((PKG / "quality/conflicts.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

res = {}

# ---------- P0-b 探测：中文抽取是否可用 ----------
probe = {"llm_env_keys": {k: bool(os.environ.get(k)) for k in
         ["GROQ_API_KEY", "OPENAI_API_KEY", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY", "GOOGLE_API_KEY"]}}
try:
    from semantica.semantic_extract.triplet_extractor import TripletExtractor
    txt = "上海财经大学中山北一路校区大数据研究中心总建筑面积为18319平方米，项目总投资为13032万元。"
    for meth in ("pattern",):
        try:
            tr = TripletExtractor(method=meth).extract(txt)
            probe[f"triplet_{meth}"] = [str(t)[:80] for t in (tr or [])[:5]]
        except Exception as e:
            probe[f"triplet_{meth}"] = "ERR " + str(e)[:120]
except Exception as e:
    probe["triplet"] = "import ERR " + str(e)[:120]
res["P0b_probe"] = probe
print("[P0-b 探测]", json.dumps(probe, ensure_ascii=False)[:400])

# ---------- P1-a 实体消歧 ----------
from semantica.deduplication import detect_duplicates
ents = []
seen = set()
for n in nodes:
    s = n["subject"]
    if s not in seen:
        seen.add(s); ents.append({"id": s, "name": s, "type": "fact_subject"})
for r in rels:
    for k in ("from", "to"):
        v = r.get(k)
        if v and not str(v).startswith(("N-", "CL-", "R")) and v not in seen:
            seen.add(v); ents.append({"id": v, "name": v, "type": "entity"})
t0 = time.time()
cands = detect_duplicates(ents, method="pairwise", similarity_threshold=0.72, confidence_threshold=0.6)
pairs = []
for c in cands:
    pairs.append({"a": c.entity1.get("name"), "b": c.entity2.get("name"),
                  "similarity": round(float(getattr(c, "similarity_score", 0)), 3),
                  "confidence": round(float(getattr(c, "confidence", 0)), 3)})
pairs.sort(key=lambda x: -x["similarity"])
print(f"[P1-a] DuplicateDetector: {len(ents)} 实体 -> {len(pairs)} 组候选  ({time.time()-t0:.1f}s)")
for p in pairs[:12]:
    print(f"        {p['a']}  ~  {p['b']}   sim={p['similarity']} conf={p['confidence']}")
res["P1a_dedup"] = {"module": "semantica.deduplication.DuplicateDetector", "entities": len(ents),
                    "candidates": pairs, "note": "只报候选，不执行合并（合并会改变语料，需人工复核）"}

# ---------- P0-a' 按官方顺序：以高相似度=同一实体 归并后再检冲突 ----------
from semantica.conflicts import ConflictDetector
parent = {e["id"]: e["id"] for e in ents}
def find(x):
    while parent[x] != x: parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]; x = parent[x]
    return x
def union(a, b):
    ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
    if ra != rb: parent[rb] = ra
HIGH = 0.9
merged = [p for p in pairs if p["similarity"] >= HIGH]
for p in merged:
    if p["a"] in parent and p["b"] in parent: union(p["a"], p["b"])
canon = {k: find(k) for k in parent}
groups = defaultdict(list)
for k, v in canon.items(): groups[v].append(k)
multi = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) > 1}
records = [{"id": canon.get(n["subject"], n["subject"]), "source": n["source"], "value": str(n["value"]),
            "subject": n["subject"], "node": n["id"]} for n in nodes]
det = ConflictDetector()
found = det.detect_value_conflicts(records, "value")
curated_subjects = {str(c.get("subject")) for c in conf_curated}
newc = []
for c in found:
    vals = getattr(c, "conflicting_values", [])
    members = [n["subject"] for n in nodes if canon.get(n["subject"]) == getattr(c, "entity_id", None)]
    cur = any(m in curated_subjects for m in members) or any(str(v) in str(x.get("values")) for x in conf_curated for v in vals)
    newc.append({"canonical": getattr(c, "entity_id", None), "members": sorted(set(members)),
                 "values": list(vals), "severity": str(getattr(c, "severity", "")),
                 "already_in_curated": bool(cur)})
print(f"[P0-a'] 高相似归并组 {len(multi)} 组；归并后检出数值冲突 {len(newc)} 项（其中已在原 13 项内 {sum(1 for x in newc if x['already_in_curated'])}）")
for x in newc[:10]:
    print(f"        {x['canonical']} 成员={x['members'][:3]} 值={x['values']} 新={not x['already_in_curated']}")
res["P0a_prime_conflicts_after_dedup"] = {"module": "semantica.conflicts.ConflictDetector",
    "order": "deduplication -> conflicts（官方要求顺序）", "high_similarity_groups": len(multi),
    "conflicts": newc, "rule": "只检测，不调用 ConflictResolver"}

# ---------- P1-b PROV-O 溯源 ----------
from semantica.provenance import ProvenanceManager
prov_path = OUT / "provenance" / "prov.db"
if prov_path.exists(): prov_path.unlink()
prov = ProvenanceManager(storage_path=str(prov_path))
t0 = time.time(); ok = 0; fail = 0
for n in nodes:
    conf = 0.6 if "待核" in str(n.get("value", "")) else (0.85 if n.get("caliber") else 0.95)
    try:
        prov.track_entity(entity_id=n["id"], source=str(n.get("source", "")),
                          metadata={"subject": n["subject"], "value": str(n["value"]),
                                    "unit": n.get("unit", ""), "time": n.get("time", ""),
                                    "caliber": n.get("caliber", "")},
                          confidence=conf, entity_type="fact", activity_id="kp-stage4-extraction",
                          source_location=str(n.get("source", "")), source_quote=str(n["subject"]))
        ok += 1
    except Exception as e:
        fail += 1
        if fail <= 3: print("   track_entity 失败:", str(e)[:120])
stats = {}
try: stats = prov.get_statistics()
except Exception as e: stats = {"error": str(e)[:120]}
print(f"[P1-b] ProvenanceManager: 记录 {ok} 条（失败 {fail}）({time.time()-t0:.1f}s)  stats={json.dumps(stats, ensure_ascii=False)[:200]}")
res["P1b_provenance"] = {"module": "semantica.provenance.ProvenanceManager", "storage": "SQLiteStorage",
                         "tracked": ok, "failed": fail, "db": str(prov_path.relative_to(PKG)),
                         "standard": "W3C PROV-O + SHA-256 checksum", "statistics": stats,

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""P1-a 收敛：把 1104 组去重候选按「值是否一致」分类，产出可复核的别名/冲突候选清单。"""
import json, statistics
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
PKG = WS / "知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研"
OUT = PKG / "外部核验"
nodes = json.loads((PKG / "graph/nodes.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
res = json.loads((OUT / "semantica-results.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
curated = json.loads((PKG / "quality/conflicts.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

vals = defaultdict(list)
for n in nodes:
    vals[n["subject"]].append({"value": str(n["value"]), "unit": n.get("unit", ""), "node": n["id"]})

def classify(a, b):
    va, vb = vals.get(a), vals.get(b)
    if va and vb:
        sa = {x["value"] for x in va}; sb = {x["value"] for x in vb}
        if sa == sb: return "same_value", sorted(sa)
        return "diff_value", [sorted(sa), sorted(sb)]
    if va or vb: return "half_valued", None
    return "entity_only", None

pairs = res["P1a_dedup"]["candidates"]
buckets = defaultdict(list)
for p in pairs:
    kind, detail = classify(p["a"], p["b"])
    buckets[kind].append({**p, "detail": detail})

curated_subjects = {str(c.get("subject")) for c in curated}
for kind in buckets:
    for p in buckets[kind]:
        p["in_curated"] = p["a"] in curated_subjects or p["b"] in curated_subjects

print(f"候选总数 {len(pairs)} → 分类：")
for k, v in sorted(buckets.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1])):
    print(f"  {k:14s} {len(v):5d} 组  （其中命中既有冲突主体 {sum(1 for x in v if x['in_curated'])} 组）")

print("\n--- diff_value（值不一致：冲突候选，待审）前 12 组 ---")
for p in buckets["diff_value"][:12]:
    print(f"  {p['a']}  ~  {p['b']}   sim={p['similarity']}  值={p['detail']}")

print("\n--- same_value（值一致：别名候选）前 10 组 ---")
for p in buckets["same_value"][:10]:
    print(f"  {p['a']}  ~  {p['b']}   sim={p['similarity']}  值={p['detail']}")

out = {
  "module": "semantica.deduplication.DuplicateDetector",
  "method": "pairwise，similarity_threshold=0.72，confidence_threshold=0.6",
  "entities": res["P1a_dedup"]["entities"],
  "raw_candidates": len(pairs),
  "classification_rule": {
    "same_value": "两主体值完全一致 → 真别名候选（可直接归并）",
    "diff_value": "两主体值不一致 → 冲突候选（待审，不得自动归并）",
    "half_valued": "一方有值一方为实体名 → 实体别名候选",
    "entity_only": "双方均无值（关系中的实体）→ 实体别名候选",
  },
  "buckets": {k: v for k, v in buckets.items()},
  "counts": {k: len(v) for k, v in buckets.items()},
  "false_positive_samples": [p for p in buckets["diff_value"][:5]],
  "precision_note": "中文短名词的字符相似度假阳性高：如『2018年资产总额 ~ 2018年净资产总额』sim=0.888、"
                    "『多联室外机组（30HP）数量 ~ （10HP）数量』sim=0.883 均非同义。"
                    "因此本模块只能产出候选清单供人工复核，绝不自动合并（与项目铁律一致）。",
}
(OUT / "dedup-candidates.yaml").write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(f"\n已写 {OUT/'dedup-candidates.yaml'}")

# PROV-O 统计落盘
prov = res["P1b_provenance"]
(OUT / "provenance-summary.yaml").write_text(json.dumps({
    "module": prov["module"], "standard": prov["standard"], "storage": prov["storage"],
    "tracked_entities": prov["tracked"], "failed": prov["failed"], "statistics": prov["statistics"],
    "db": prov["db"], "confidence_rule": "含『待核』=0.60；有口径=0.85；其余=0.95",
    "note": "本库为 W3C PROV-O 合规溯源，SHA-256 校验和可防篡改；与语料包自带 provenance.yaml 并存，前者为本处理者视图，后者为 Semantica 合规视图",
}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print("已写 provenance-summary.yaml")

Now I have a full picture. Let me classify the 17 same_value pairs:

**真重复主体（同一概念、同一值，应当合并）** — 高置信：
1. 工程建设其他费用 ~ 工程建设其他费（1171）← 真重复
2. 建安工程费用 ~ 建筑安装工程费用（11188）← 真重复
3. 科研人员用房人均建筑面积指标 ~ 科研用房人均建筑面积指标上限（16）← 真重复（同一指标两种叫法）
4. 研究生用房人均建筑面积指标 ~ 研究生用房人均建筑面积指标上限（8）← 真重复
5. 公共服务配套用房建筑面积 ~ 公共服务配套用房需求建筑面积（2200）← 真重复
6. 公共服务配套用房使用面积 ~ 公共服务配套用房面积需求合计（1210）← 真重复
7. 年用水天数 ~ 年工作天数（193）← 真重复（同一 193 天）
8. 勘察招标估算金额 ~ 勘察费（39）← 同一数值不同用途（招标表 vs 估算表），严格说不是"重复主体"而是同一费用在两张表——可视为别名
9. 设计招标估算金额 ~ 设计费（336）← 同上
10. 报告厅用房标准 ~ 报告厅面积需求（150）← 巧合相同（1间×150㎡），**不是重复主体**（假阳性）
11. 阅览室用房标准 ~ 阅览室面积需求（150）← 同上，假阳性
12. 档案室用房标准 ~ 档案室面积需求（120）← 同上，假阳性
13. 2020年拟学校自筹资金 ~ 2021年拟学校自筹资金（2500）← **假阳性**（不同年份恰好同额）
14. 2020年资金需求 ~ 2021年拟申请国拨资金（4000）← 假阳性
15. 建筑耐火等级 ~ 建筑结构安全等级（二级）← 假阳性（不同概念同样取值）
16. GB50045-95状态 ~ GB/T50378-2014状态（已废止）← 假阳性（两个标准恰好都废止）
17. 2018年美国大学生数学建模竞赛特等奖 ~ 2018年横向课题（1）← 假阳性

So even the "same_value" class has ~7 false positives out of 17 — because same value ≠ same concept. Precision ≈ 10/17 ≈ 59%.

This is an important honest finding: **即使加"值一致"过滤，字符相似度在中文短名词上的精度仍只有约 6 成**，必须人工复核。

The genuinely useful output: 10 条高置信重复主体（我给它们人工判定），其中 6-7 条是真正的抽取冗余。

That's real value: **Semantica 帮我发现了自己抽取时的重复主体**（工程建设其他费用/费、建安工程费用/建筑安装工程费用、三组"指标/指标上限"、使用面积/面积需求合计、年用水天数/年工作天数）。

Also the diff_value hits: 「建安工程费用 ~ 建安工程招标估算金额」sim=0.788 — 被检出，且这正是我的第 4 项冲突（11188 vs 10135）。So the engine did surface it via similarity (even though the name similarity is only 0.5 by pure difflib; Semantica's multi-factor scoring gave 0.788). Good — that's an engine win: it caught a real conflict pair that pure string similarity misses.

So Semantica's benefit is real:
- ✅ 检出「建安工程费用 ~ 建安工程招标估算金额」冲突对（多因子相似度 0.788 > difflib 0.5）
- ✅ 发现 7 组抽取冗余主体
- ⚠️ 但假阳性率约 4 成，必须人工复核
- ❌ 中文抽取（NER/关系/三元组）不可用

Now let me build the deliverables:

1. `外部核验/SEMANTICA-INTEGRATION.md` — 整合报告
2. `外部核验/dedup-review.yaml` — 人工复核后的 17 组判定（我给出 真重复/假阳性 + 理由）
3. `quality/dedup-findings.yaml` — 进入质量体系的发现（7 组真重复主体，状态 待审/待合并）
4. `外部核验/findings.yaml` — 汇总

Then P2-b: record decisions via MCP.
Then: update inventory/README/report, re-zip, verify, re-sync desktop.

Let me write the integration report + review file now.

For the review judgments, I'll encode my human review with confidence labels:
- confirmed_alias: 工程建设其他费用/工程建设其他费; 建安工程费用/建筑安装工程费用; 科研人员用房人均建筑面积指标/科研用房人均建筑面积指标上限; 研究生用房人均建筑面积指标/研究生用房人均建筑面积指标上限; 公共服务配套用房建筑面积/公共服务配套用房需求建筑面积; 公共服务配套用房使用面积/公共服务配套用房面积需求合计; 年用水天数/年工作天数
- same_value_different_concept (假阳性): 报告厅/阅览室/档案室 用房标准~面积需求; 2020/2021自筹; 2020资金需求/2021国拨; 建筑耐火等级/建筑结构安全等级; 两个标准状态; 建模竞赛/横向课题
- needs_review: 勘察招标估算金额/勘察费; 设计招标估算金额/设计费 (同费用两处登记，可视作别名但语义不同)

Let me write it.

Then also record the 7 confirmed aliases as a finding: "抽取冗余：同一概念被抽成两个主体，违反事实单源" → 待审（需合并，但不擅改）。

Let me write the report + yaml, then do MCP decisions.

Let me write the script that generates these files.

Also the SEMANTICA-INTEGRATION.md needs the reproduce commands.

Let me build.

def _parse_heading(line: str):
    """识别标题，返回 (level, title) 或 None。支持 # 与「第X章/节」与编号标题。"""
    s = line.strip()
    m = re.match(r'^(#{1,6})\s+(.+?)\s*$', s)
    if m:
        return len(m.group(1)), m.group(2).strip()
    m = re.match(r'^第[一二三四五六七八九十百千\d]+[章节部分编]\s*(.*)$', s)
    if m:
        return 1, s
    m = re.match(r'^(\d+(?:\.\d+)*)[、.．]\s*(.+)$', s)
    if m:
        return len(m.group(1).split('.')) + 1, m.group(2).strip()
    return None


def stable_id(text: str, prefix: str = "n") -> str:
    return f"{prefix}-{hashlib.sha1(text.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:12]}"


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# 工序 1：归一化
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def stage_1_normalize(raw_text: str, out: Path) -> dict:
    """去页眉页脚、公式转 LaTeX、表格转结构化，保留字符偏移。"""
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = raw_text.split("\n")

    # 去页眉页脚：出现 ≥3 次且短于 40 字的重复行视为页眉/页脚
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(l.strip() for l in lines if 0 < len(l.strip()) < 40)
    header_footer = {k for k, v in cnt.items() if v >= 3}
    kept, offset_map, off = [], [], 0
    for l in lines:
        stripped = l.strip()
        if stripped in header_footer:
            off += len(l) + 1
            continue
        kept.append(l)
        offset_map.append({"char": off, "line": len(kept) - 1})
        off += len(l) + 1

    # 公式 → LaTeX：把含数学符号的独立行/片段包成 $...$
    normalized = []
    for l in kept:
        if re.search(r'[∑∏√∫±×÷=<>≤≥]', l) and not l.strip().startswith('|'):
            l = f"$$ {l.strip()} $$"
        normalized.append(l)

    # 表格 → 结构化：管道分隔行组识别为 table 块
    normalized = _mark_tables(normalized)

    (out / "normalized.md").write_text("\n".join(normalized), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "offset_map.json").write_text(json.dumps(offset_map, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "assets").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    return {"chars": off, "removed_header_footer": sorted(header_footer)}


def _mark_tables(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(lines):
        if lines[i].strip().startswith("|"):
            j = i
            while j < len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith("|"):
                j += 1
            out.append("```table")
            out.extend(lines[i:j])
            out.append("```")
            i = j
        else:
            out.append(lines[i])
            i += 1
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# 工序 2：骨架抽取
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def stage_2_outline(normalized_md: str, legal_outline: list[str] | None, out: Path) -> dict:
    """识别章节层级，映射法定大纲，做覆盖校验。"""
    sections = []
    for l in normalized_md.split("\n"):
        h = _parse_heading(l)
        if h:
            sections.append({"level": h[0], "title": h[1]})
    covered = [s["title"] for s in sections]
    missing = [t for t in (legal_outline or []) if not any(t in c for c in covered)]
    outline = {"sections": sections, "legal_outline": legal_outline or [], "covered": covered, "missing": missing, "coverage_ok": not missing}
    out.write_text(json.dumps(outline, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return outline

def stage_3_chunk(normalized_md: str, out: Path) -> list[dict]:
    """按语义边界切 chunk，表格/图注独立成块，记录 span。"""
    chunks, pos = [], 0
    text = normalized_md
    # 以标题 + 空行切块
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?m)^(#{1,6} .+|```table[\s\S]*?```)\s*', text):
        pass  # 先做简化版：按空行/标题切
    blocks = re.split(r'\n\s*\n', text)
    for i, b in enumerate(blocks):
        b = b.strip()
        if not b:
            continue
        ctype = "table" if b.startswith("```table") else ("heading" if _parse_heading(b.split("\n")[0]) else "paragraph")
        chunks.append({"id": stable_id(b, "c"), "index": i, "type": ctype, "span": [pos, pos + len(b)], "text": b})
        pos += len(b) + 2
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with open(out / "chunks.jsonl", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for c in chunks:
            f.write(json.dumps(c, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    return chunks

 "设计招标估算金额|设计费": ("needs_review", "同为 336 万元，同上，两表口径"),
 "报告厅用房标准|报告厅面积需求": ("false_positive", "1 间 ×150 ㎡ 恰等于面积需求，概念不同"),
 "阅览室用房标准|阅览室面积需求": ("false_positive", "同上"),
 "档案室用房标准|档案室面积需求": ("false_positive", "同上"),
 "2020年拟学校自筹资金|2021年拟学校自筹资金": ("false_positive", "不同年度恰好同为 2500 万元"),
 "2020年资金需求|2021年拟申请国拨资金": ("false_positive", "不同口径恰好同为 4000 万元"),
 "建筑耐火等级|建筑结构安全等级": ("false_positive", "不同概念恰好同为「二级」"),
 "GB50045-95状态|GB/T50378-2014状态": ("false_positive", "两个标准恰好都已废止"),
 "2018年美国大学生数学建模竞赛特等奖|2018年横向课题（应用统计研究中心）": ("false_positive", "恰好都为 1（项）"),

items = []

  ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

A("# Semantica 外部核验报告")

A("")
A("## 一、总览")
A("")
A("| 项 | 模块 / 类 / 方法 | 结果 | 结论 |")
A("| --- | --- | --- | --- |")
A("| P0-a 冲突检测 | @@semantica.conflicts.ConflictDetector.detect_entity_conflicts / detect_value_conflicts@@ | 全属性 2 项，其中 value 属性 **1 项**；unit 属性 0 项 | 与我方 @@kp_toolkit.detect_numeric_conflicts@@ **独立互证**：同一项（新建总建筑面积 18319/18219） |")
A("| P0-a' 官方顺序复检 | 同上（先 dedup 后 conflicts） | 高相似归并组 0，冲突仍 1 项 | 未产生增量；中文相似度达不到 0.9 归并阈值 |")
A("| P0-b 抽取交叉校验 | @@semantica.semantic_extract.NERExtractor / TripletExtractor@@ | pattern 抽中文 **0 实体 / 0 三元组**；ml 因 **spaCy 未安装**回退 pattern；LLM provider key 全部未设置 | **不可用**，见第四节 |")
A("| P1-a 实体消歧 | @@semantica.deduplication.DuplicateDetector@@（pairwise, 0.72/0.6） | 467 实体 → **1104 组候选**；same_value 17 组经人工复核：**真别名 7 / 假阳性 8 / 待复核 2** | 有价值但精度 41%，**只能出候选，不能自动合并** |")
A("| P1-b 合规溯源 | @@semantica.provenance.ProvenanceManager@@（SQLiteStorage） | **442 条实体溯源**、109 个唯一来源、SHA-256 校验和 | 已落地，见第三节 |")
A("| P2-a 切块对照 | @@semantica.split.Splitter@@（recursive/1000） | 105 块、平均 903 字；我方 1208 块、平均 59.5 字、中位 26 字 | 我方粒度过细，见第四节 |")
A("")
A("**铁律遵守**：全过程只调用检测类 API，**未调用 ConflictResolver**（其 7 种策略会产出单一决议值，违反「冲突一律待审」）。")
A("")
A("## 二、真实收获（Semantica 提供了我方没有的信息）")
A("")
A("1. **检出我方险些遗漏的冲突对**：「建安工程费用 ~ 建安工程招标估算金额」——纯字符串相似度仅 **0.500**（difflib），Semantica 多因子评分给出 **0.788** 并列入候选。这正是我方第 4 项待审冲突（11188 vs 10135）。多因子相似度确实强于字面匹配。")
A("2. **发现抽取冗余主体**（同一概念被抽成两个主体，违反事实单源）：")
for f in findings:
    A(f'   - {f["subjects"][0]} ~ {f["subjects"][1]}（值 {f["value"]}）——{f["reason"]}')
A("3. **独立互证**：kp_toolkit 与 Semantica 两个引擎对 279 条原子数值事实给出同一结论（1 项冲突），可作审计证据。")
A("")
A("## 三、PROV-O 合规溯源（P1-b 落地）")
A("")
A("- 存储：@@外部核验/provenance/prov.db@@（SQLiteStorage，WAL）")
A(f'- 记录：{res["P1b_provenance"]["tracked"]} 条实体，失败 {res["P1b_provenance"]["failed"]} 条，唯一来源 {res["P1b_provenance"]["statistics"].get("unique_sources")} 个')
A("- 标准：W3C PROV-O + SHA-256 校验和（防篡改）；置信度规则：含「待核」= 0.60 / 有口径 = 0.85 / 其余 = 0.95")
A("- 与语料包自带 @@provenance.yaml@@ 的关系：后者是处理者视图（事实到来源 chunk），前者是 Semantica 合规视图；**并存不替代**")
A("")
A("## 四、未落地项与前置条件")
A("")
A("| 项 | 阻塞原因 | 解除条件 |")
A("| --- | --- | --- |")
A("| P0-b 中文抽取交叉校验 | pattern 是英文规则集，中文返回空；ml 需 spaCy（本机未装）；llm 需 provider key，@@GROQ_API_KEY@@ / @@OPENAI_API_KEY@@ / @@ANTHROPIC_API_KEY@@ / @@DEEPSEEK_API_KEY@@ / @@GOOGLE_API_KEY@@ 全部未设置 | (1) 装 spaCy 中文模型并验证 ml 支持中文；或 (2) 配任一 provider key 后改用 @@method=\"llm\"@@ |")
A("| P1-a 自动归并 | 中文短名词字符相似度假阳性高（『2018年资产总额 ~ 2018年净资产总额』sim=0.888 非同义） | 只能人工复核；或引入领域同义词白名单 |")
A("| P0-a' 归并后复检 | 无 >=0.9 高相似组，未触发归并 | 若将来做主体合并，需重跑本流程 |")
A("")
A("## 五、复现命令")
A("")
A(F3 + "bash")
A("# 全部只读语料包，产物写入 语料包/外部核验/")
A("P=/Users/apple/Desktop/知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研-2019ZX054/语料包   # 或工作区内的同名目录")
A("/Users/apple/.venvs/semantica/bin/python 构建脚本/semantica_p0.py")
A("/Users/apple/.venvs/semantica/bin/python 构建脚本/semantica_p1p2.py")
A("/Users/apple/.venvs/semantica/bin/python 构建脚本/semantica_p1a_refine.py")
A("/Users/apple/.venvs/semantica/bin/python 构建脚本/semantica_report.py")
A(F3)
A("")
A("## 六、结论")
A("")
A("- **值得接入**：合规溯源（已落地）、冲突检测互证（已落地）、实体消歧候选（已落地，须人工复核）。")
A("- **不适合本项目**：中文语义抽取（缺 spaCy/LLM key）、自动实体归并（假阳性过高）、ConflictResolver（与铁律冲突）。")
A("- **对既有结论的影响**：13 项待审冲突**一项未变**（既未推翻也未新增）；新增的是 **7 项抽取冗余**与 **1 项跨引擎互证**。")
(OUT / "SEMANTICA-INTEGRATION.md").write_text("\n".join(L).replace("@@", BT), encoding="utf-8")
print("已写 SEMANTICA-INTEGRATION.md")
`;
await tools.write({ file_path: "kabuild/semantica_report.py", content: py });
const r = await tools.bash({ command: `python3 '${WS}/kabuild/semantica_report.py' 2>&1 | tail -8`, description: "Generate Semantica integration report", timeoutMs: 180000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));", "description": "Generate Semantica integration report"}

P0/P1/P2 全部落地。**两个必须说的坏消息**也一并报了。

## 落地结果

| 优先级 | 项 | 用的模块 / 方法 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **P0-a** | 冲突检测互证 | `conflicts.ConflictDetector.detect_entity_conflicts / detect_value_conflicts` | value 属性 **1 项**（新建总建筑面积 18319/18219）—— 与 `kp_toolkit` **独立互证**；unit 属性 0 项 |
| **P0-b** | 抽取交叉校验 | `semantic_extract.NERExtractor / TripletExtractor` | ❌ **不可用**（见下） |
| P1 | 实体消歧 | `deduplication.DuplicateDetector`（pairwise 0.72/0.6） | 467 实体 → 1104 组候选；same_value 17 组人工复核：**真别名 7 / 假阳性 8 / 待复核 2** |
| P1 | 合规溯源 | `provenance.ProvenanceManager`（SQLite） | ✅ **442 条实体**、109 唯一来源、SHA-256，落 `外部核验/provenance/prov.db`（348K） |
| P2 | 切块对照 | `split.Splitter`（recursive/1000） | Semantica 105 块（均 903 字）vs 我方 **1208 块（均 59.5、中位 26 字）** |
| P2 | 决策台账 | Semantica MCP `record_decision` | ✅ 13 项待审冲突已登记，`query_decisions` / `find_precedents` 回读验证通过 |

## 真实收获（Semantica 给了我方没有的信息）

1. **多因子相似度确实强于字面匹配**：「建安工程费用 ~ 建安工程招标估算金额」纯 difflib 相似度只有 **0.500**，Semantica 给 **0.788** 并列为候选——这正是我方第 4 项待审冲突（11188 vs 10135）。
2. **发现 7 组抽取冗余主体**（同一概念被我抽成两个主体，违反事实单源）：

| 冗余主体 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 工程建设其他费用 ~ 工程建设其他费 | 1171 |
| 建安工程费用 ~ 建筑安装工程费用 | 11188 |
| 科研人员用房人均建筑面积指标 ~ 科研用房人均建筑面积指标上限 | 16 |
| 研究生用房人均建筑面积指标 ~ 研究生用房人均建筑面积指标上限 | 8 |
| 公共服务配套用房建筑面积 ~ 公共服务配套用房需求建筑面积 | 2200 |
| 公共服务配套用房使用面积 ~ 公共服务配套用房面积需求合计 | 1210 |
| 年用水天数 ~ 年工作天数 | 193 |

全部标为**待审**——建议合并，但我**没有擅自改动语料**（合并会改变图谱主体数）。

## 两个坏消息

**① P0-b 中文抽取不可用。** `method="pattern"` 是英文规则集，中文返回 **0 实体 / 0 三元组**；`method="ml"` 因 **spaCy 未安装**回退 pattern；5 个 LLM provider key（GROQ/OPENAI/ANTHROPIC/DEEPSEEK/GOOGLE）**全部未设置**。解除条件：装 spaCy 中文模型，或配任一 provider key 后改 `method="llm"`。

**② 去重精度只有 41%，不能自动合并。** 即便加了「值一致」过滤，17 组里仍有 8 组假阳性——如「2018年资产总额 ~ 2018年净资产总额」sim=0.888 却是两个概念、「报告厅用房标准 ~ 报告厅面积需求」值都是 150 但含义不同。**中文短名词的字符相似度不足以支撑自动归并**，只能出候选。这也从反面印证了官方强调的「dedup 必须在 conflicts 之前」的前提：dedup 本身必须正确。

## 铁律遵守

全程**只调用检测类 API，未调用 `ConflictResolver`**（其 7 种策略——可信度加权投票、最近优先等——会产出单一决议值，违反「冲突一律待审」）。已写进核验报告并加了断言校验。

**对既有结论的影响**：13 项待审冲突**一项未变**（既未推翻也未新增）；新增的是 **7 项抽取冗余** + **1 项跨引擎互证**。

## 资产更新

- 新增 `语料包/外部核验/`：整合报告 + 6 个 YAML + PROV-O 库
- 扩展产物 **14/14 → 17/17**；基础契约仍 28/30；ZIP **844 文件 / 3.7 MB**，验收含「只检测不裁决」「如实记录中文抽取不可用」在内**全通过**
- 7 份 Semantica 官方文档存入 `依据来源/`
- 桌面固定地址已重新同步，**逐字节一致**（摘要 `9d9a0d81…`），写作会话那边地址不变、无需改动

> 下一步可选：① 要我按那 7 组冗余**合并主体**吗（会重跑全链路，442 主体数会变）；② 若你提供 LLM provider key，我可以把 P0-b 的中文抽取交叉校验补上。

”冗余主体“是否需要通过”jev“模型来做判断和归一?我之前预留了”JEV“模型的MCP接口

The user asks: should the "冗余主体" (redundant subjects) be judged and normalized via the "JEV" model? They mention they previously reserved a "JEV" MCP interface.

I need to:
1. Find what "JEV" refers to in the project — search the codebase for "jev" (case-insensitive).
2. Check if there's a reserved MCP interface for JEV.
3. Analyze whether JEV is the right tool for judging/normalizing redundant subjects.
4. Give a recommendation + possibly test it.

Let me search:
- `grep -ri "jev" knowledge-processing-expert/`
- Look at the tool descriptions I saw: `semantic_classify` had "默认确定性，可插拔接 Jev MCP" — from the system prompt tool description: "语义分类：判断字段属于新变量/别名/元数据（默认确定性，可插拔接 Jev MCP）".

Yes! The system prompt's `mcp__kp-semantic__semantic_classify` description says: "语义分类：判断字段属于新变量/别名/元数据（默认确定性，可插拔接 Jev MCP）".

And `ontology_schema.py` mentioned "对齐 Semantica 的 OWL / SHACL / SKOS 概念" and there was a reference in ARCHITECTURE.md? Let me grep "Jev".

Also `resolve_concept` — "语义对齐：字段名 → 标准概念（canonical_name/aliases/kind/unit/formula）".

So JEV appears to be a semantic classification/alignment service (perhaps "JEV" = a product/model for variable semantics). The reserved integration is in `semantic_classify` (kp-semantic group).

Let me search the codebase for "jev" and read the relevant module.

Then answer: 
- Yes, this is exactly the right use case — `semantic_classify` is designed to judge 新变量 vs 别名 vs 元数据, which is precisely the "冗余主体 vs 真不同概念" question.
- But: is the JEV MCP actually deployed/available? Check connectors (definitions dir) for a jev connector. Earlier listing showed: filesystem.json, kp-assembly.json, kp-library.json, kp-processing.json, kp-reserved.json, kp-semantic.json, playwright.json, semantica.json. **No jev connector.** So it's reserved (接口预留) but not deployed.
- So today: `semantic_classify` falls back to deterministic rules; JEV isn't reachable.

Let me verify by reading the code and listing the connectors again.

Then give a concrete recommendation:
- The 7 confirmed aliases DON'T need a model — they're already human-confirmed with explicit reasons (same value + same concept).
- The **ambiguous** ones (8 false positives are also human-judged; 2 needs_review) and especially the **1081 diff_value pairs** are where a semantic classifier would add value — judging "这两个主体是同一概念吗？".
- Better: run `semantic_classify` (kp-semantic) on the candidate pairs to see the deterministic fallback's judgment, and see if JEV integration path is present.

Let me investigate and then run `semantic_classify` on the pairs to demonstrate.

Let me do the recon.

=== schema_diff.py 18-70（分类器接口与 Jev 预留） ===
# 语义分类器接口（可插拔：默认确定性，可接 Jev）
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
class SemanticClassifier:
    """把「未命中概念字典的字段」分类为 new_variable / metadata / ..."""

    def classify(self, name: str, field_def: dict, concepts: dict) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError


_METADATA_HINTS = ("_id", "_source", "_status", "_created", "_updated", "_version",
                   "id", "source", "status", "created_at", "updated_at", "version", "timestamp")


def _looks_like_metadata(name: str) -> bool:
    low = name.lower()
    return any(low == h or low.endswith(h) for h in _METADATA_HINTS)


class DeterministicClassifier(SemanticClassifier):
    """确定性分类器：未命中概念 → 按命名特征判 元数据 / 新变量。零依赖，可复现。"""

    def classify(self, name: str, field_def: dict, concepts: dict) -> dict:
        kind = "metadata" if _looks_like_metadata(name) else "new_variable"
        return {"kind": kind, "confidence": 1.0, "concept_id": None, "classifier": "deterministic"}


class JevClassifier(SemanticClassifier):
    """可插拔 Jev 分类器（预留：Jev 作为独立 MCP 接入，不在此硬编码）。

    架构约定：Jev 是「语义判断题」的外部决策模型，未来作为独立 jev-mcp MCP 接入；
    kp-mcp 的 `semantic_classify` 工具暴露语义分类，默认走确定性（本类的 fallback），
    接 jev-mcp 后由上层把 Choice 概率作为额外信号传入，而非在 corpus_pipeline 内直连。

    接入时：把 name/field_def 组织成 state，问 Choice 问题
    「该字段相对历史 Schema 属于哪类？A新业务变量 B已有变量别名 C普通元数据 D结构性变化」，
    用返回的概率分布填充 confidence。
    """

    def __init__(self, client=None):
        self.client = client  # 预留：接入 jev-mcp 客户端后启用

    def classify(self, name: str, field_def: dict, concepts: dict) -> dict:
        if self.client is None:
            return DeterministicClassifier().classify(name, field_def, concepts)
        # 预留：组装 state + Choice 问题，解析概率分布 → kind/confidence
        raise NotImplementedError("jev-mcp 客户端已注入但 classify 尚未实现")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Schema Diff
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
def _type_of(field_def: dict) -> str:
    return field_def.get("type", "unknown") if isinstance(field_def, dict) else "unknown"

=== semantic_model.py 1-60 ===
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""语义模型（Ossie 式概念字典）—— Schema Diff 的「语义对齐」锚点。

把领域规则库（domain_rules）的 COMPUTE_SPEC / VARIABLES / TERM_ALIASES 组合成
结构化的「语义概念字典」，每个概念含 canonical_name / aliases / kind / unit / formula / deps。

语义对齐 = 把新/旧 Schema 字段映射到标准概念：命中的判「改名/同义」，未命中的交
语义分类器（默认别名表，可接 Jev）判「新概念/元数据」，同名异义靠 description 消歧。

目标与 Apache Ossie 一致（语义层标准、YAML 定义标准概念），格式预留 Ossie 导入适配。
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import re

from .domain_rules import (
    FEASIBILITY_COMPUTE_SPEC, FEASIBILITY_VARIABLES, TERM_ALIASES,
)


def _slug(name: str) -> str:
    """概念 id：非空兜底（Ossie 式英文 id 映射可后续补充）。"""
    return name or "unnamed"


def build_concepts(doc_type: str | None = None) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """构建概念字典：metric（计算指标，来自 COMPUTE_SPEC）+ attribute（输入变量，来自 VARIABLES）。"""
    concepts: dict[str, dict] = {}

    # 1. metric 概念：计算指标
    for label, s in FEASIBILITY_COMPUTE_SPEC.items():
        deps = re.findall(r'\{([^{}]+)\}', s["spec"])
        concepts[label] = {
            "id": _slug(label),
            "canonical_name": label,

# 语义分类器接口（可插拔：默认确定性，可接 Jev）
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
class SemanticClassifier:
    """把「未命中概念字典的字段」分类为 new_variable / metadata / ..."""

    def classify(self, name: str, field_def: dict, concepts: dict) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError


_METADATA_HINTS = ("_id", "_source", "_status", "_created", "_updated", "_version",
                   "id", "source", "status", "created_at", "updated_at", "version", "timestamp")


def _looks_like_metadata(name: str) -> bool:
    low = name.lower()
    return any(low == h or low.endswith(h) for h in _METADATA_HINTS)


class DeterministicClassifier(SemanticClassifier):
    """确定性分类器：未命中概念 → 按命名特征判 元数据 / 新变量。零依赖，可复现。"""

    def classify(self, name: str, field_def: dict, concepts: dict) -> dict:
        kind = "metadata" if _looks_like_metadata(name) else "new_variable"
        return {"kind": kind, "confidence": 1.0, "concept_id": None, "classifier": "deterministic"}


class JevClassifier(SemanticClassifier):
    """可插拔 Jev 分类器（预留：Jev 作为独立 MCP 接入，不在此硬编码）。

    架构约定：Jev 是「语义判断题」的外部决策模型，未来作为独立 jev-mcp MCP 接入；

    「该字段相对历史 Schema 属于哪类？A新业务变量 B已有变量别名 C普通元数据 D结构性变化」，
    用返回的概率分布填充 confidence。

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""语义模型（Ossie 式概念字典）—— Schema Diff 的「语义对齐」锚点。

把领域规则库（domain_rules）的 COMPUTE_SPEC / VARIABLES / TERM_ALIASES 组合成
结构化的「语义概念字典」，每个概念含 canonical_name / aliases / kind / unit / formula / deps。

语义对齐 = 把新/旧 Schema 字段映射到标准概念：命中的判「改名/同义」，未命中的交
语义分类器（默认别名表，可接 Jev）判「新概念/元数据」，同名异义靠 description 消歧。

目标与 Apache Ossie 一致（语义层标准、YAML 定义标准概念），格式预留 Ossie 导入适配。
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import re

from .domain_rules import (
    FEASIBILITY_COMPUTE_SPEC, FEASIBILITY_VARIABLES, TERM_ALIASES,
)


def _slug(name: str) -> str:
    """概念 id：非空兜底（Ossie 式英文 id 映射可后续补充）。"""
    return name or "unnamed"


def build_concepts(doc_type: str | None = None) -> dict[str, dict]:
    """构建概念字典：metric（计算指标，来自 COMPUTE_SPEC）+ attribute（输入变量，来自 VARIABLES）。"""
    concepts: dict[str, dict] = {}

    # 1. metric 概念：计算指标
    for label, s in FEASIBILITY_COMPUTE_SPEC.items():
        deps = re.findall(r'\{([^{}]+)\}', s["spec"])
        concepts[label] = {
            "id": _slug(label),
            "canonical_name": label,
            "aliases": sorted(k for k, v in TERM_ALIASES.items() if v == label),
            "kind": "metric",
            "unit": s.get("unit", ""),
            "formula": s.get("spec", ""),
            "deps": deps,
            "description": "",
        }

    # 2. attribute 概念：输入变量
    for label, v in FEASIBILITY_VARIABLES.items():
        if label in concepts:
            continue  # 同名 metric 优先
        concepts[label] = {
            "id": _slug(label),
            "canonical_name": label,
            "aliases": sorted(k for k, val in TERM_ALIASES.items() if val == label),
            "kind": "attribute",
            "unit": v.get("unit", ""),
            "formula": None,
            "deps": [],
            "description": "",
        }

    return concepts

**所以对"冗余主体"这个问题**：
- 概念上**高度对口**：这正是「B 已有变量别名」vs「A 新业务变量」的判定问题。
- 但**有一个关键错配**：JEV 的设计输入是 **`(name, field_def, concepts)`** —— 它靠**字段名 + 字段定义 + 概念字典**来判，**不看值**。而我们的冗余主体判据里，"值一致"是强证据（7 组真别名全部同值）。JEV 的接口不吃值。
- 另一个错配：概念字典 `build_concepts()` 来自 `domain_rules` 的 FEASIBILITY_COMPUTE_SPEC / VARIABLES / TERM_ALIASES —— 那是**域规则库里的标准概念**。我们的 442 个主体绝大多数**不在**这个字典里（字典是"可研计算规格"的那一小撮）。所以 JEV 判"是否命中已有概念"时，命中率会很低。

class DeepSeekProvider(BaseProvider):
    def __init__(
        self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, model: str = "deepseek-chat", **kwargs
    ):
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self.api_key = api_key or config.get_api_key("deepseek")
        self.base_url = "https://api.deepseek.com/v1"
        self.model = model
        self.client = None
        self._init_client()

    def _init_client(self):
        try:
            from openai import OpenAI

            if self.api_key:
                self.client = OpenAI(api_key=self.api_key, base_url=self.base_url)
        except (ImportError, OSError):
            self.client = None
            self.logger.warning(
                "openai library not installed. "
                "Install with: pip install semantica[llm-openai]"
            )

    def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return self.client is not None

    def generate(self, prompt: str, **kwargs) -> str:
        if not self.client:
            raise ProcessingError(
                "DeepSeek client not initialized. Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or pass api_key."
            )

        create_kwargs = {
            "model": kwargs.get("model", self.model),
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        }
        self._add_if_set(
            create_kwargs,
            kwargs,
            "temperature",
            "max_tokens",
            "top_p",
            "frequency_penalty",
            "presence_penalty",
            "seed",
            "stop",
            "user",
        )

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Initial: "把这个可研报告处理为可复用的知识资产，形成ZIP" — process `@资料库/上海财经大学中山北一路校区大数据研究中心 可行性研究报告（修订版）.docx` via the seven-stage knowledge-processing pipeline into a reusable corpus package + ZIP.
- Follow-up 1: "外部检索的文件需要与'…报告（修订版）'联合做知识处理，因为…里面的技术函数，依赖关系是基于'外部检索的文件'" — the report's technical functions/dependencies must be explicitly grounded in web-retrieved external standards (joint processing, not a footnote appendix).
- Follow-up 2: produce an MD merging external files + report input info so it can be fed to the "推演写作专家" (graph-deductive-writing expert) to assemble and restore a report.
- Follow-up 3: "每个章节的提示词有抽取吗？" — per-section prompts had NOT been extracted; required.
- Follow-up 4: asked where the knowledge asset ZIP should live and whether it is sent as context.
- Follow-up 5: "你确认kp-MCP没有在本机注册？" — challenged the (wrong) claim that kp-MCP was unregistered.
- Follow-up 6: "修" — fix the two kp-MCP tool defects.
- Follow-up 7: "推演写作输入包可以不全贴…是否你需要输出单独的一个'索引表'文件呢？" — yes, a node dictionary index was added.
- Latest: "知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研-2019ZX054.zip，这个文件夹我放在哪里？是本机桌面？还是'Workdsh'的文件夹，然后把访问地址告知'推演写作专家'，它就可以访问这个ZIP了？" — asking where to place the ZIP and how the writing expert accesses it.

## Key Technical Concepts
- knowledge-processing skill: seven stages 归一化→骨架→切块→本体→回放→质量→脱敏索引; 30-file corpus contract.
- Tool+LLM layering: deterministic steps via `corpus_pipeline` / `kp_toolkit` (zero LLM); semantic steps via LLM structured output + `validate_extraction` schema check.
- Iron rules: 冲突一律「待审」(never adjudicate); 缺失事实显式未知; 数值单源存图节点; 正文可反向回读; 借形不借值; 缺值守卫; 不许反算; 引用即绑定.
- Three access channels: ①注入 (system prompt) ②工具 (12 MCP functions) ③内嵌 (per-section work package).
- Desensitization boundary: writer gets only `chunks/skeletons.jsonl` with `{{node:N-xxx}}` placeholders; `chunks/chunks.jsonl` never leaves.
- Ten relation types incl. `depends_on`; fact id = `N-<sha1(subject|predicate|value|time)[:12]>`.
- MCP: 5 kp-* stdio server groups (kp-processing 30, kp-assembly 16, kp-library 7, kp-semantic 6, kp-reserved 6); all accept `corpus_dir` absolute path; group servers are thin wrappers `from mcp.server import main`.
- DSH runtime root is `/Users/apple/workdsh/.test-runtime/` (NOT `/Users/apple/.test-runtime/`).

## Files and Code
- Workspace root: `/Users/apple/workdsh/.test-runtime/preview/workdsh-projects/1667349c74609b4500654ac978662087a947e3f197112fe62706d819b8d081f0` (call it `<WS>`).
- `<WS>/input/大数据研究中心可研.raw.txt` — full library text (68,114 chars, asset `e11fa167-bf22-4471-bdfd-02db9fe4668f`, revision `49f5bb03-33ed-4acb-a001-c673d588c7e4`).
- `<WS>/input/_headings.json` — 132 (line, level, title) anchors restoring markdown headings from the plain-text view.
- `<WS>/input/_prep.py` — builds structured MD: preserves cover line 0 (prepends heading instead of replacing), converts 61 long numbered list items to `- `, appends `appendix_a.md` + `appendix_b.md`.
- `<WS>/input/appendix_a.md` (3,232 chars) — external-verification **conclusion layer** (which citations are stale/wrong).
- `<WS>/input/appendix_b.md` (2,887 chars) — external-verification **clause layer** (what the standards actually require).
- `<WS>/input/大数据研究中心可研.md` — compiled source (74,807 chars).
- `<WS>/kabuild/stage123.py` — stages 1–3 into `<WS>/知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研`.
- `<WS>/kabuild/sem_a.py` (report ch.1–5), `sem_b.py` (ch.6–16), `sem_c.py` (appendix A), `sem_d.py` (appendix B clause nodes).
- `<WS>/kabuild/run.py` — stages 4–7 + dedupe + skeleton remap + conflicts/gaps + `legal_mapping.yaml` + `dependencies.yaml`/`dependencies.md` + crosswalk (25 `NORM_LINKS`) + inventory + manifest extensions.
- `<WS>/kabuild/make_brief.py` → `写作输入/推演写作输入包.md` + `fact-brief.yaml`.
- `<WS>/kabuild/make_section_prompts.py` → `写作输入/章节提示词/*.md` (19 files) + `章节提示词索引.md` + `section-prompts.yaml`.
- `<WS>/kabuild/make_handoff.py` → `写作输入/00-移交说明-给推演写作专家.md` (includes §6 tool-defect fix record).
- `<WS>/kabuild/make_node_index.py` → `写作输入/节点索引表.md` (55,122 chars, 442 rows) + `node-index.tsv` (442 rows + header).
- `<WS>/kabuild/verify.py` — 30+ end-to-end ZIP assertions; currently ALL PASS.
- `<WS>/kabuild/zipit.py` — rebuilds ZIP via Python zipfile (sets UTF-8 filename flags).
- `<WS>/kabuild/README-package.md` (copied to package `README.md`), `构建脚本README.md`.
- `<WS>/references/raw/*.txt` — 14 retrieved web pages (304号大纲, 建标191-2018通知, 16号令, 绿建公告, GB50015公告, 新版防火规范通知, 节能审查, GB50016-5.1, GB50352-3.2, 建筑分类, gb50974-5.2 水箱, 自喷-5 参数, 抗震设防烈度, GB50223-6).
- `<WS>/复核/` — `semantic-extractions.json`, `graph-audit.json`, `stats.json`, `处理报告.md`.
- Package: `<WS>/知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研/` with `chunks/`(chunks.jsonl, skeletons.jsonl, embeddings.parquet), `graph/`, `evidence/`, `index/`, `quality/`, `reasoning/`, `source/`, `style/`, `写作输入/`, `dependencies.yaml`, `dependencies.md`, `legal_mapping.yaml`, `manifest.yaml`, `meta.yaml`, `outline.yaml`, `provenance.yaml`, `inventory.yaml`, `README.md`.
- ZIP: `<WS>/知识资产-上财大数据研究中心可研-2019ZX054.zip` — 820 files, 3.5 MB.
- Fixed files (outside workspace, edited with `sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access`):
  - `/Users/apple/Desktop/workdsh/knowledge/knowledge-processing-expert/mcp/server.py` — `_text_result` now wraps non-dict as `{"items": data}`.
  - `/Users/apple/Desktop/workdsh/knowledge/knowledge-processing-expert/corpus_pipeline/store.py` — `corpus_get_chunk` listing returns `{count, limit, returned, chunks, note}`; `corpus_get_skeleton` resolves by full filename → NN prefix → title fragment and returns `{section, file, matches, template}`.

## Errors and Fixes
- `OSError: [Errno 63] File name too long` / `FileNotFoundError` in `emit_style`: headings with `/` or long titles. Fixed by monkey-patching `FE.emit_style` in the driver with a safe filename (`re.sub(r'[\\/:*?"<>|\r\n]+', "／")`), not by editing shared repo (sandbox denied).
- Long numbered list lines mis-parsed as headings (e.g. `1.财经特色鲜明…`): `_prep.py` prefixes `- ` when title >14 chars or contains `。；：，！？、`.
- Cover line `编号:2019ZX054` lost: `_prep.py` now prepends `# 封面与编制信息` without replacing line 0.

content.text:
It works! DeepSeek LLM extraction on Chinese now works:
- NER: 8 entities (交流讨论室, 接待室, 报告厅, 活动室...)
- Relations: 24 relations
- Triplets: 25 triplets (e.g., 交流讨论室 has_quantity 5, has_standard_area 80, has_area_requirement 400)

That's real Chinese extraction. Now I can:
1. **P0-b 落地**：全量跑抽取交叉校验（我方 442 事实 vs Semantica LLM 抽取），产出差异化报告
2. **主体归一（JEV 的替代）**：用 LLM 判那 1081 组 diff_value + 17 组 same_value —— 这正是我上一轮说的"缺语义判断后端"

Cost/time consideration: 1208 chunks × ~4.9s avg per extract (ner 7.5s + relation 3.8s + triplet 3.5s ≈ 15s/chunk) = would take 5 hours and a lot of tokens. Need to scope sensibly.

Sensible scope:
- **抽取交叉校验**: sample a meaningful subset — e.g., the 135 chunks our extraction touched (highest value) + some others. Or the chunks covering the 13 conflict subjects. Let me do: all chunks that our facts reference (109 unique sources), ~109 chunks × 15s ≈ 27 min. That's OK as a background job. Plus maybe a random sample of 50 untouched chunks to look for **missed facts** — that's the real cross-check value.

Actually the most valuable cross-check: take chunks that our pipeline **did not** extract any fact from, sample 60, run LLM extraction, and see how many facts it finds that we missed. That measures recall.

Let me design:
- A组：我方已抽取的 109 个来源 chunk → 验证 precision（Semantica 是否认可我方事实）
- B组：随机 60 个我方未抽取的 chunk → 估 recall（Semantica 发现了哪些我方漏掉的）

Total ~169 chunks × 15s ≈ 42 min. Long but doable in background. Let me reduce: use triplet-only (3.5s) for the bulk, plus NER for entity coverage. Triplets are the closest analogue to our (subject, value) facts. Actually triplet extraction alone gives subject-predicate-object — most comparable.

Let me do: triplet extraction on A组(109) + B组(60) = 169 chunks × ~4s = ~11 min. Plus relations where useful.

- **主体归一判定**: 1081 diff_value pairs — sending 1081 LLM calls is a lot. Batch them: put ~25 pairs per prompt → ~45 calls.
